compatibility.notes: Harden exact MCP Host and Origin allowlists and private atomic file publication.

notes: Version 1.4.1 provides standards-compliant stdio and stateless Streamable HTTP transports. HTTP remains loopback-only, uses exact parsed Host and Origin allowlists, bounds request bodies, supports JSON or SSE POST responses, and requires an environment-sourced Bearer gate before enabling writes. Atomic publications are private by default and preserve only ordinary existing access bits. Runtime trust still requires an exact reviewed-core payload hash.
